pattern: SELECT .+ FROM .+ AS T1 JOIN .+ AS T2 ON T1\.id = T2\.Channel WHERE T2\.Title = '(.*?)'
correction:
Replace the SELECT clause with SELECT T1.\<series_column>
Remove T1.id from the SELECT clause
Ensure that the title in the WHERE clause is enclosed in double quotes

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries where the incorrect column (id) is selected instead of the required series column
